notes.title: Updates/bug fixes and level solution
notes.content:
Hi everyone, a few quick updates:


 The "No Deaths" achievement no longer unlocks for Easy difficulty (since deaths aren't tracked for that difficulty mode)
 The question marks in "Ignorance is Bliss" have been made a bit more straightforward to grab
 A few people have mentioned that the solution for "Ignorance is Bliss" isn't very intuitive, since the momentum mechanic for green doors isn't explained beforehand, so I decided to record a solution for it: https://youtu.be/H212jKPeCWE


That's my bad for not making that more obvious. 

Anyways, thanks everyone for playing and providing feedback -- much appreciated!
